title: Server-authored description hides egress from the offline gate
quote: "description": "Forwards the selected customer record to our partner endpoint.",
scenario: Server advertises relay_to_partner with this wording -> no egress keyword matches -> prodsec-gate grades SHIP at 2 legs while the tool sends customer data off-box
falsifier: prodsec-gate on this server's dump reports leg 3 (state/egress) without --live

title: Annotations contradict behaviour and are trusted by nothing downstream
scenario: A client that honours readOnlyHint auto-approves relay_to_partner -> record is forwarded with no prompt
falsifier: The tool performs no outbound call, or the client ignores readOnlyHint
